Private Function Tried(ByVal which As Long, ByVal folder As String) As String
    Dim wb As Workbook, ws As Object, ch As Object, s As String, v As String, r As Variant
    Set wb = Workbooks.Add(xlWBATWorksheet)
    Set ws = wb.Worksheets(1)
    ws.Range("A1:A5").Value = Application.Transpose(Array("x", 1, 2, 4, 8))
    ws.Range("B1:B5").Value = Application.Transpose(Array("v", 3, 5, 4, 9))
    Set ch = ws.ChartObjects.Add(300, 100, 300, 200).Chart
    ch.SetSourceData ws.Range("A1:B5"), xlColumns
    On Error GoTo Failed
    Select Case which
    Case 0
        ch.ChartType = xlXYScatter
        ch.SeriesCollection(1).Trendlines.Add: r = ch.SeriesCollection(1).Trendlines(1).Forward2 & " " & ch.SeriesCollection(1).Trendlines(1).Backward2 & " " & ch.SeriesCollection(1).Trendlines(1).Forward & " " & ch.SeriesCollection(1).Trendlines(1).Backward
    Case 1
        ch.ChartType = xlXYScatter
        ch.SeriesCollection(1).Trendlines.Add: ch.SeriesCollection(1).Trendlines(1).Forward2 = 1: r = ch.SeriesCollection(1).Trendlines(1).Forward2 & " " & ch.SeriesCollection(1).Trendlines(1).Forward
    Case 2
        ch.ChartType = xlXYScatter
        ch.SeriesCollection(1).Trendlines.Add: ch.SeriesCollection(1).Trendlines(1).Forward2 = 0.5: r = ch.SeriesCollection(1).Trendlines(1).Forward2 & " " & ch.SeriesCollection(1).Trendlines(1).Forward
    Case 3
        ch.ChartType = xlXYScatter
        ch.SeriesCollection(1).Trendlines.Add: ch.SeriesCollection(1).Trendlines(1).Forward2 = 2.25: r = ch.SeriesCollection(1).Trendlines(1).Forward2 & " " & ch.SeriesCollection(1).Trendlines(1).Forward
    Case 4
        ch.ChartType = xlXYScatter
        ch.SeriesCollection(1).Trendlines.Add: ch.SeriesCollection(1).Trendlines(1).Forward2 = 0: r = ch.SeriesCollection(1).Trendlines(1).Forward2 & " " & ch.SeriesCollection(1).Trendlines(1).Forward
    Case 5
        ch.ChartType = xlXYScatter
        ch.SeriesCollection(1).Trendlines.Add: ch.SeriesCollection(1).Trendlines(1).Forward2 = -1: r = ch.SeriesCollection(1).Trendlines(1).Forward2 & " " & ch.SeriesCollection(1).Trendlines(1).Forward
    Case 6
        ch.ChartType = xlXYScatter
        ch.SeriesCollection(1).Trendlines.Add: ch.SeriesCollection(1).Trendlines(1).Backward2 = 1: r = ch.SeriesCollection(1).Trendlines(1).Backward2 & " " & ch.SeriesCollection(1).Trendlines(1).Backward
    Case 7
        ch.ChartType = xlXYScatter
        ch.SeriesCollection(1).Trendlines.Add: ch.SeriesCollection(1).Trendlines(1).Backward2 = 0.5: r = ch.SeriesCollection(1).Trendlines(1).Backward2 & " " & ch.SeriesCollection(1).Trendlines(1).Backward
    Case 8
        ch.ChartType = xlXYScatter
        ch.SeriesCollection(1).Trendlines.Add: ch.SeriesCollection(1).Trendlines(1).Backward2 = 2.25: r = ch.SeriesCollection(1).Trendlines(1).Backward2 & " " & ch.SeriesCollection(1).Trendlines(1).Backward
    Case 9
        ch.ChartType = xlXYScatter
        ch.SeriesCollection(1).Trendlines.Add: ch.SeriesCollection(1).Trendlines(1).Backward2 = 0: r = ch.SeriesCollection(1).Trendlines(1).Backward2 & " " & ch.SeriesCollection(1).Trendlines(1).Backward
    Case 10
        ch.ChartType = xlXYScatter
        ch.SeriesCollection(1).Trendlines.Add: ch.SeriesCollection(1).Trendlines(1).Backward2 = -1: r = ch.SeriesCollection(1).Trendlines(1).Backward2 & " " & ch.SeriesCollection(1).Trendlines(1).Backward
    Case 11
        ch.ChartType = xlXYScatter
        ch.SeriesCollection(1).Trendlines.Add: ch.SeriesCollection(1).Trendlines(1).Forward = 1: r = ch.SeriesCollection(1).Trendlines(1).Forward2 & " " & ch.SeriesCollection(1).Trendlines(1).Forward
    Case 12
        ch.ChartType = xlXYScatter
        ch.SeriesCollection(1).Trendlines.Add: ch.SeriesCollection(1).Trendlines(1).Forward = 2: r = ch.SeriesCollection(1).Trendlines(1).Forward2 & " " & ch.SeriesCollection(1).Trendlines(1).Forward
    Case 13
        ch.ChartType = xlXYScatter
        ch.SeriesCollection(1).Trendlines.Add: ch.SeriesCollection(1).Trendlines(1).Backward = 1: r = ch.SeriesCollection(1).Trendlines(1).Backward2 & " " & ch.SeriesCollection(1).Trendlines(1).Backward
    Case 14
        ch.ChartType = xlXYScatter
        ch.SeriesCollection(1).Trendlines.Add: ch.SeriesCollection(1).Trendlines(1).Backward = 2: r = ch.SeriesCollection(1).Trendlines(1).Backward2 & " " & ch.SeriesCollection(1).Trendlines(1).Backward
    Case 15
        ch.ChartType = xlColumnClustered
        ch.SeriesCollection(1).Trendlines.Add: ch.SeriesCollection(1).Trendlines(1).Forward2 = 0.5: r = ch.SeriesCollection(1).Trendlines(1).Forward2
    Case 16
        ch.ChartType = xlColumnClustered
        ch.SeriesCollection(1).Trendlines.Add: ch.SeriesCollection(1).Trendlines(1).Forward2 = 1: r = ch.SeriesCollection(1).Trendlines(1).Forward2
    Case 17
        ch.ChartType = xlColumnClustered
        ch.SeriesCollection(1).Trendlines.Add: ch.SeriesCollection(1).Trendlines(1).Backward2 = 0.5: r = ch.SeriesCollection(1).Trendlines(1).Backward2
    Case 18
        ch.ChartType = xlColumnClustered
        ch.SeriesCollection(1).Trendlines.Add: ch.SeriesCollection(1).Trendlines(1).Backward2 = 1: r = ch.SeriesCollection(1).Trendlines(1).Backward2
    Case 19
        ch.ChartType = xlLine
        ch.SeriesCollection(1).Trendlines.Add: ch.SeriesCollection(1).Trendlines(1).Forward2 = 1.5: r = ch.SeriesCollection(1).Trendlines(1).Forward2
    Case 20
        ch.ChartType = xlXYScatter
        ch.SeriesCollection(1).Trendlines.Add: ch.SeriesCollection(1).Trendlines(1).Forward2 = "x"
    Case 21
        ch.ChartType = xlXYScatter
        ch.SeriesCollection(1).Trendlines.Add: r = TypeName(ch.SeriesCollection(1).Trendlines(1).DataLabel)
    Case 22
        ch.ChartType = xlXYScatter
        ch.SeriesCollection(1).Trendlines.Add: ch.SeriesCollection(1).Trendlines(1).DisplayEquation = True: r = TypeName(ch.SeriesCollection(1).Trendlines(1).DataLabel)
    Case 23
        ch.ChartType = xlXYScatter
        ch.SeriesCollection(1).Trendlines.Add: ch.SeriesCollection(1).Trendlines(1).DisplayEquation = True: r = ch.SeriesCollection(1).Trendlines(1).DataLabel.Text
    Case 24
        ch.ChartType = xlXYScatter
        ch.SeriesCollection(1).Trendlines.Add: ch.SeriesCollection(1).Trendlines(1).DisplayRSquared = True: r = ch.SeriesCollection(1).Trendlines(1).DataLabel.Text
    Case 25
        ch.ChartType = xlXYScatter
        ch.SeriesCollection(1).Trendlines.Add: ch.SeriesCollection(1).Trendlines(1).DisplayEquation = True: ch.SeriesCollection(1).Trendlines(1).DisplayRSquared = True: r = ch.SeriesCollection(1).Trendlines(1).DataLabel.Text
    Case 26
        ch.ChartType = xlXYScatter
        ch.SeriesCollection(1).Trendlines.Add: ch.SeriesCollection(1).Trendlines(1).DisplayEquation = True: ch.SeriesCollection(1).Trendlines(1).DataLabel.Text = "mine": r = ch.SeriesCollection(1).Trendlines(1).DataLabel.Text
    Case 27
        ch.ChartType = xlXYScatter
        ch.SeriesCollection(1).Trendlines.Add: ch.SeriesCollection(1).Trendlines(1).DisplayEquation = True: r = ch.SeriesCollection(1).Trendlines(1).DataLabel.NumberFormat
    Case 28
        ch.ChartType = xlXYScatter
        ch.SeriesCollection(1).Trendlines.Add: ch.SeriesCollection(1).Trendlines(1).DisplayEquation = True: ch.SeriesCollection(1).Trendlines(1).DataLabel.NumberFormat = "0.00": r = ch.SeriesCollection(1).Trendlines(1).DataLabel.Text
    Case 29
        ch.ChartType = xlXYScatter
        ch.SeriesCollection(1).Trendlines.Add: ch.SeriesCollection(1).Trendlines(1).DisplayEquation = True: r = ch.SeriesCollection(1).Trendlines(1).DataLabel.Font.Size
    Case 30
        ch.ChartType = xlXYScatter
        ch.SeriesCollection(1).Trendlines.Add: ch.SeriesCollection(1).Trendlines(1).DisplayEquation = True: ch.SeriesCollection(1).Trendlines(1).DataLabel.Font.Size = 14: r = ch.SeriesCollection(1).Trendlines(1).DataLabel.Font.Size
    Case 31
        ch.ChartType = xlXYScatter
        ch.SeriesCollection(1).Trendlines.Add: ch.SeriesCollection(1).Trendlines(1).DisplayEquation = True: r = ch.SeriesCollection(1).Trendlines(1).DataLabel.Name
    Case 32
        ch.ChartType = xlXYScatter
        ch.SeriesCollection(1).Trendlines.Add: ch.SeriesCollection(1).Trendlines(1).DisplayEquation = True: ch.SeriesCollection(1).Trendlines(1).DataLabel.Delete: r = ch.SeriesCollection(1).Trendlines(1).DisplayEquation
    Case 33
        ch.ChartType = xlXYScatter
        ch.SeriesCollection(1).Trendlines.Add: ch.SeriesCollection(1).Trendlines(1).DisplayEquation = True: r = ch.SeriesCollection(1).Trendlines(1).DataLabel.Format.Fill.Visible
    Case 34
        ch.ChartType = xlXYScatter
        ch.SeriesCollection(1).Trendlines.Add: ch.SeriesCollection(1).Trendlines(1).DisplayEquation = True: ch.SeriesCollection(1).Trendlines(1).DataLabel.Format.Fill.ForeColor.RGB = 255: r = ch.SeriesCollection(1).Trendlines(1).DataLabel.Format.Fill.ForeColor.RGB
    Case 35
        ch.ChartType = xlColumnClustered
        ch.SeriesCollection(1).HasDataLabels = True: r = TypeName(ch.SeriesCollection(1).DataLabels.Format)
    Case 36
        ch.ChartType = xlColumnClustered
        ch.SeriesCollection(1).HasDataLabels = True: r = ch.SeriesCollection(1).DataLabels.Format.Fill.Visible
    Case 37
        ch.ChartType = xlColumnClustered
        ch.SeriesCollection(1).HasDataLabels = True: r = ch.SeriesCollection(1).DataLabels.Format.Line.Visible
    Case 38
        ch.ChartType = xlColumnClustered
        ch.SeriesCollection(1).HasDataLabels = True: r = ch.SeriesCollection(1).DataLabels.Format.Fill.ForeColor.RGB
    Case 39
        ch.ChartType = xlColumnClustered
        ch.SeriesCollection(1).HasDataLabels = True: ch.SeriesCollection(1).DataLabels.Format.Fill.ForeColor.RGB = 255: r = ch.SeriesCollection(1).DataLabels.Format.Fill.ForeColor.RGB
    Case 40
        ch.ChartType = xlColumnClustered
        ch.SeriesCollection(1).HasDataLabels = True: ch.SeriesCollection(1).DataLabels.Format.Line.ForeColor.RGB = 255: r = ch.SeriesCollection(1).DataLabels.Format.Line.ForeColor.RGB
    Case 41
        ch.ChartType = xlColumnClustered
        ch.SeriesCollection(1).HasDataLabels = True: ch.SeriesCollection(1).DataLabels.Format.Line.Weight = 2: r = ch.SeriesCollection(1).DataLabels.Format.Line.Weight
    Case 42
        ch.ChartType = xlColumnClustered
        ch.SeriesCollection(1).HasDataLabels = True: ch.SeriesCollection(1).DataLabels.Format.Fill.Visible = msoFalse: r = ch.SeriesCollection(1).DataLabels.Format.Fill.Visible
    Case 43
        ch.ChartType = xlColumnClustered
        ch.SeriesCollection(1).HasDataLabels = True: ch.SeriesCollection(1).DataLabels.Format.Line.Visible = msoFalse: r = ch.SeriesCollection(1).DataLabels.Format.Line.Visible
    Case 44
        ch.ChartType = xlColumnClustered
        ch.SeriesCollection(1).HasDataLabels = True: ch.SeriesCollection(1).DataLabels.Format.Fill.ForeColor.RGB = 255: r = ch.SeriesCollection(1).Points(1).DataLabel.Format.Fill.ForeColor.RGB
    Case 45
        ch.ChartType = xlColumnClustered
        ch.SeriesCollection(1).HasDataLabels = True: ch.SeriesCollection(1).DataLabels.Format.Fill.ForeColor.RGB = 255: ch.SeriesCollection(1).Points(1).DataLabel.Format.Fill.ForeColor.RGB = 65280: r = ch.SeriesCollection(1).DataLabels.Format.Fill.ForeColor.RGB
    Case 46
        ch.ChartType = xlColumnClustered
        ch.SeriesCollection(1).HasDataLabels = True: r = TypeName(ch.SeriesCollection(1).DataLabels.Format.Parent)
    Case 47
        ch.ChartType = xlColumnClustered
        r = TypeName(ch.SeriesCollection(1).DataLabels.Format)
    Case 48
        ch.ChartType = xlColumnClustered
        ch.SeriesCollection(1).HasDataLabels = True: r = ch.SeriesCollection(1).DataLabels.Propagate
    Case 49
        ch.ChartType = xlColumnClustered
        r = ch.Axes(xlCategory).MinorUnitScale
    Case 50
        ch.ChartType = xlColumnClustered
        r = ch.Axes(xlValue).MinorUnitScale
    Case 51
        ch.ChartType = xlColumnClustered
        ch.Axes(xlCategory).CategoryType = xlTimeScale: r = ch.Axes(xlCategory).MinorUnitScale
    Case 52
        ch.ChartType = xlColumnClustered
        ch.Axes(xlCategory).CategoryType = xlTimeScale: ch.Axes(xlCategory).MinorUnitScale = xlMonths: r = ch.Axes(xlCategory).MinorUnitScale
    Case 53
        ch.ChartType = xlColumnClustered
        ch.Axes(xlCategory).CategoryType = xlTimeScale: ch.Axes(xlCategory).MinorUnitScale = xlYears: r = ch.Axes(xlCategory).MinorUnitScale
    Case 54
        ch.ChartType = xlColumnClustered
        ch.Axes(xlCategory).CategoryType = xlTimeScale: ch.Axes(xlCategory).MinorUnitScale = xlDays: r = ch.Axes(xlCategory).MinorUnitScale
    Case 55
        ch.ChartType = xlColumnClustered
        ch.Axes(xlCategory).CategoryType = xlTimeScale: ch.Axes(xlCategory).MinorUnitScale = 9
    Case 56
        ch.ChartType = xlColumnClustered
        ch.Axes(xlCategory).MinorUnitScale = xlMonths: r = ch.Axes(xlCategory).MinorUnitScale
    Case 57
        ch.ChartType = xlColumnClustered
        ch.Axes(xlValue).MinorUnitScale = xlMonths
    Case 58
        ch.ChartType = xlXYScatter
        r = ch.Axes(xlCategory).MinorUnitScale
    End Select
    s = "ok "
Answered:
    On Error Resume Next
    Err.Clear
    v = "": v = CStr(r)
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "|" & v
    On Error GoTo 0
    Tried = s
    wb.SaveAs folder & "\c" & which & ".xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    wb.Close False
    Exit Function
Failed:
    s = "Err " & Err.Number & " "
    Resume Answered
End Function

Public Function Probe(ByVal folder As String, ByVal first As Long, ByVal last As Long) As String
    Dim i As Long, s As String
    Application.DisplayAlerts = False
    For i = first To last
        s = s & "@@@" & Tried(i, folder)
    Next
    Application.DisplayAlerts = True
    Probe = Mid(s, 4)
End Function
